title: Automate TLS + KMS rotation for private-installer: Vault sealed-secrets & HSM integration
author: Asha Menon
description: Motivation: Private deployments need automated, auditable TLS/certificate and KMS key rotations that work with Vault + sealed-secrets and optional HSM/KMS backing. Current manual rotation is error-prone and leads to expired cert incidents during upgrades. This PR implements an automated rotation workflow in the private-installer that: 1) integrates with customer-provided KMS/HSM or Vault transit for key wrapping, 2) coordinates certificate generation and incremental rollout across the cluster, 3) leverages sealed-secrets (or the equivalent secret-store in air-gapped installs) to store rotated certs, and 4) provides upgrade/rollback safe hooks for the installer and Helm charts. Changes are split across the Helm chart, Terraform KMS module, a new rotation controller Job, and docs/upgrade notes. Implementation details: - Add a new helm template `templates/cert-rotation-job.yaml` which runs as a Kubernetes Job (can be scheduled via CronJob) that:  * fetches current cert metadata, requests new certs from step-issuer (Vault PKI or local signer),  * wraps keys using customer KMS/HSM (via kms-plugin shim) or Vault transit,  * creates sealed secrets with rotated certs and annotations for canary rollout. - Introduce `values.yaml` toggles: `rotation.enabled`, `rotation.strategy` (rolling/canary), `rotation.kms.provider` (vault|awskms|gcpkms|hsm), `rotation.safe_window` to coordinate TTLs. - Terraform: add `redwood-terraform/modules/kms` support for HSM-backed key resource and IAM bindings needed for private deployments. - Installer hooks: upgrade pre-hook validates cert TTLs and schedules rotation job when upgrade would overlap with cert expiry; rollback hook marks last-good sealed-secret and re-applies. - RBAC: minimal ServiceAccount/Role changes for rotation job to read Secrets, create SealedSecrets, and annotate Deployments. - Observability: emit metrics `rotation_attempts`, `rotation_success`, `rotation_failures`, and emit events for audit. - Docs: add private-installer/README rotation section and upgrade notes with rollback instructions and expected downtime (none for rolling, up to 2m for canary failover). Testing and validation: - Unit tests for KMS shim logic (local mock HSM) and sealed-secret creation. - End-to-end test in perf-canary using real Vault dev server and a simulated HSM plugin. - Manual dry-run mode added to the Job to surface diffs without applying. Rollout plan: 1) merge to main behind feature flag (values.rotation.enabled=false by default), 2) ship as opt-in for early adopters, 3) enable in staging with real Vault/KMS, 4) GA with docs and a migration job for existing installs. Rollback notes: job creates timestamped sealed-secret backups; rollback uses the last-good annotation to restore. Related: ENG-4231, INFRA-217, SUP-1182.

release_notes: Add automated TLS and KMS rotation for private-installer with configurable strategies (rolling/canary), Vault transit and HSM/KMS support, Terraform module updates for HSM, upgrade/rollback hooks, and observability for rotation operations.
notes_for_ops: Default behavior is disabled (values.rotation.enabled=false). Enable per-cluster via values file or installer flag.
When enabling with a short cert TTL, run in dry-run mode first to validate sealed-secret generation.
Ensure KMS/HSM credentials are available to installer (see docs).
Installer pre-upgrade hook checks cert TTLs and will block if rotation would overlap with upgrade window unless force flag provided.
upgrade_rollback_instructions: Upgrade: set values.rotation.enabled=true and choose strategy=rolling or canary. Monitor rotation_success metric. Rollback: set values.rotation.enabled=false and re-apply helm chart; the rollback hook will revert to last-good sealed-secret using annotation 'rotation.last_good'. For emergency revert, run the included restore script in private-installer/scripts/rotation/restore_last_good.sh
tests_and_validation: Unit tests coverage for kms_shim: mock HSM and vault transit scenarios
e2e perf-canary run against Vault dev server + simulated HSM (added retry logic)
Manual dry-run to generate sealed-secret diffs before enabling
Canary rollout validated on staging with 0 user-facing error rate
